# Dre Dyson

> > Technical guides and strategic insights for developers and CTOs navigating AI-powered development tools, IDE workflows, and enterprise software challenges.

Dre Dyson provides in-depth tutorials, case studies, and strategic analyses focused on Cursor IDE, AI pair programming with Claude and GPT models, Git workflow optimization, and the intersection of development tooling with business concerns like cybersecurity insurance, technical debt, and CTO decision-making.

## Key Topics

- Cursor IDE
- AI Pair Programming
- Git Workflow & Version Control
- File Deletion & Data Recovery
- Claude (Opus 4.5, 4.6)
- GPT-4 & GPT-5-mini
- CTO Strategy & Technical Debt
- Developer Tools Troubleshooting
- Cybersecurity Insurance
- VSCode Configuration
- Prompt Engineering
- CI/CD & Deployment
- HIPAA Compliance
- Node.js & Express
- IDE Hook Failures
